name: Prism Nav
summary: A floating glass website menu that magnifies and bends the page, with a stretchy highlight
about: A pill-shaped website menu that acts like a thick piece of glass: the stripes and shapes of the page are magnified and gently warped as they scroll under it, and a glint follows your pointer across it. A soft white highlight stretches and thins like putty from link to link, the menu tracks the section you are reading, and the page content rises in as you scroll with tilting project cards. Good for portfolios, studio sites and app landing pages.
how: Scroll the page and watch the content bend and magnify as it passes under the glass, while new content rises in.
Point at a link or Tab to it: the highlight's leading edge jumps ahead, the trailing edge follows and the pill thins as it stretches.
Click a link to glide to that section; move away and the highlight springs back to the current section.
Hover a project card to tilt it in 3D with a moving glare; press it and it squishes slightly.
